title: Driving idea about notes
transcript: Driving thought. The app should not ask what kind of note this is before I talk. Let the note be whatever it is and classify it after. That feels core to the promise.

expected.title: Classify notes after speaking
expected.summary: The user thinks Throughline should not ask for note type before recording and should classify the note afterward.
intentions: Let the note be whatever it is and classify it after recording
